# U Hirable

> U Hirable is a free hiring hub. Job seekers can search live jobs in the UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Kuwait, Bahrain, Egypt, the United States, the United Kingdom, Canada, Germany, Spain, India, Pakistan, South Africa, the Philippines and Indonesia, see typical salaries and employer requirements by job title and city, and check their CV against a job ad for free. Companies can find recruiting support and hiring tools. The site is run by a recruiter and is free to use.

Each "jobs in city" page shows live openings from job-search partners (updated daily), a typical salary range, what employers ask for, where the jobs are, and tips before applying. Some outbound job and tool links are partner links; see the affiliate disclosure.

## Search jobs
- [Search Jobs](https://uhirable.github.io/jobs.html): live job search by keyword and country
- [Remote Jobs](https://uhirable.github.io/remote-jobs.html): fully remote roles with the countries you can apply from
- [Visa Sponsorship Jobs](https://uhirable.github.io/visa-sponsorship-jobs.html): roles that sponsor work visas
- [Work From Home Jobs for Beginners](https://uhirable.github.io/work-from-home-jobs-for-beginners.html): entry-level remote roles and how to apply

## Jobs and salaries by country
- [Jobs in the UAE](https://uhirable.github.io/uae.html): Dubai jobs by title, salaries in AED
- [Jobs in Saudi Arabia](https://uhirable.github.io/saudi-arabia.html): Riyadh jobs by title, salaries in SAR
- [Jobs in Qatar](https://uhirable.github.io/qatar.html): Doha jobs by title, salaries in QAR
- [Jobs in Kuwait](https://uhirable.github.io/kuwait.html): Kuwait City jobs by title, salaries in KWD
- [Jobs in Bahrain](https://uhirable.github.io/bahrain.html): Manama jobs by title, salaries in BHD
- [Jobs in Egypt](https://uhirable.github.io/egypt.html): Cairo jobs by title, salaries in EGP
- [Jobs in the United States](https://uhirable.github.io/usa.html): US jobs by title, salaries in USD
- [Jobs in London](https://uhirable.github.io/london.html): London jobs by title, salaries in GBP and visa sponsorship notes

Example title pages follow the pattern https://uhirable.github.io/{title}-jobs-in-{city}.html, for example [Accountant jobs in Dubai](https://uhirable.github.io/accountant-jobs-in-dubai.html), [Nurse jobs in London](https://uhirable.github.io/nurse-jobs-in-london.html) and [Software engineer jobs in Cairo](https://uhirable.github.io/software-engineer-jobs-in-cairo.html).

## Walk-in interviews
- [Walk-in interviews around the world](https://uhirable.github.io/walk-in-interviews.html): confirmed hiring events and job fairs for the current month by country, each linked to the organiser, updated monthly
- [UK visa sponsorship companies](https://uhirable.github.io/uk-visa-sponsors.html): searchable copy of the Home Office register of employers licensed to sponsor UK work visas, by company name or town, refreshed monthly from GOV.UK
- [Canada LMIA employers list](https://uhirable.github.io/canada-lmia-employers.html): searchable list of employers in Canada issued a positive LMIA in the last four quarters, by job, city or province, from the official Open Canada dataset

## Career guides
- [UK CV format](https://uhirable.github.io/uk-cv-format.html): what UK employers expect on a CV, what to leave out, free template, live UK jobs
- [UK nursing jobs with visa sponsorship](https://uhirable.github.io/uk-nurse-visa-sponsorship-jobs.html): Health and Care Worker visa, NMC registration steps and costs, NHS starting pay, live nursing jobs
- [Remote jobs from Egypt that pay in dollars](https://uhirable.github.io/remote-jobs-from-egypt-usd.html): contractor vs employer of record, what to ask before accepting, live remote jobs
- [Jobs in Germany for English Speakers](https://uhirable.github.io/jobs-in-germany-for-english-speakers.html): visa routes, 2026 salary thresholds, the Opportunity Card for job seekers, live jobs in Germany
- [German CV Format (Lebenslauf)](https://uhirable.github.io/german-cv-format.html): what German employers expect on a CV, free template, live jobs in Germany
- [Jobs in Canada for Foreigners](https://uhirable.github.io/jobs-in-canada-for-foreigners.html): employer-specific vs open work permits, LMIA, scam warnings, live jobs in Canada
- [Canadian Resume Format](https://uhirable.github.io/canadian-resume-format.html): what Canadian employers expect on a resume, what to leave out, live jobs in Canada
- [Jobs in Kuwait for Expats](https://uhirable.github.io/jobs-in-kuwait-for-expats.html): how the work permit and Article 18 residence work, documents to prepare, live jobs in Kuwait
- [Jobs in Bahrain for Expats](https://uhirable.github.io/jobs-in-bahrain-for-expats.html): LMRA work permit, who pays, right to change employer, grace period, live jobs in Bahrain
- [Gulf Jobs for Indian Applicants](https://uhirable.github.io/gulf-jobs-for-indian-applicants.html): registered recruiting agents, legal limit on agent fees, ECR clearance, PBBY insurance, live Gulf jobs
- [Fresh Graduate Jobs in Egypt](https://uhirable.github.io/fresh-graduate-jobs-in-egypt.html): search words for entry-level jobs, CV with no experience, live jobs in Egypt
- [All career guides](https://uhirable.github.io/guides.html): each guide lists its official sources and the date it was last checked

## Free CV tools
- [CV Match Checker](https://uhirable.github.io/cv-match.html): match score, missing keywords and ATS format check against a job ad; runs in the browser, nothing uploaded
- [CV Builder](https://uhirable.github.io/cv-builder.html): build an ATS-friendly CV
- [CV Templates](https://uhirable.github.io/cv-templates.html): free Word CV templates
- [CV Tools](https://uhirable.github.io/cv-tools.html): a guide to free and paid CV tools
- [Career Boost](https://uhirable.github.io/career-boost.html): free AI tools for job seekers

## For companies
- [Hire Talent](https://uhirable.github.io/employer.html): recruiting support for companies
- [Hiring Partners](https://uhirable.github.io/partners.html): EOR, payroll, staffing and recruiting tools
